analyst.summary: Ramkrishna Forgings is Eastern India's largest forging company, serving commercial-vehicle, rail, and industrial customers. FY26 profit fell sharply (partly due to an unusually large one-off tax credit inflating the prior year's base), though the most recent quarter (Q1 FY27) showed a genuine recovery with profit up sharply year-on-year off a low base, alongside a fresh capex announcement. However, leverage is elevated, interest coverage is flagged as low, and the business carries real exposure to the auto sector's shift away from internal-combustion drivetrains. At 108-149 times trailing earnings, we rate this a Sell.
